title: Weekday Finder
description:
Read a date in `DD/MM/YYYY` form and print the weekday name.

Example: `14/03/2025` prints `Friday`.
starter_code:
from datetime import datetime

text = input()
# Print the weekday name
solution_code:
from datetime import datetime

text = input()
print(datetime.strptime(text, '%d/%m/%Y').strftime('%A'))
